ThingDef.label: Olive
ThingDef.description: A citrus fruit harvested from an orange tree. Has a characteristic taste.

ThingDef.label: Dionius
ThingDef.description: Desert plant with external rhizome. It has a calming effect, which potentially helps in the fight against drug addiction.

ThingDef.label: Cardium
ThingDef.description: Swamp plant with a strong stem. The use in the form of soup causes a beneficial effect on the hematopoietic and circulatory system. The patient tolerates blood loss more easily, and the symptoms of heart disease sometimes cease to bother him at all.

ThingDef.label: Rhinocarpus
ThingDef.description: A rather tasty and vitamin-rich plant that grows in the jungle. Rhinos often eat the fruit, from which the plant got its name.

ThingDef.label: Beans
ThingDef.description: Raw beans, edible. They are quite nutritious food.

ThingDef.label: Tomato
ThingDef.description: The red vegetable of a herbaceous plant.

ThingDef.label: Bulb onions
ThingDef.description: One of the most important and widespread vegetable crops, known for over 8 thousand years. Bulbs and leaves are used as a seasoning in the canning industry, for salads, vinaigrette, mushrooms, vegetable and meat dishes, as well as a spicy vitamin snack and flavoring additive to soups, sauces, minced meat.

ThingDef.label: Carrot
ThingDef.description: One of the most important and widespread vegetable crops, known for over 8 thousand years. Bulbs and leaves are used as a seasoning in the canning industry, for salads, vinaigrette, mushrooms, vegetable and meat dishes, as well as a spicy vitamin snack and flavoring additive to soups, sauces, minced meat.

ThingDef.label: Cucumber
ThingDef.description: The pimpled fruit of the plant contains a large amount of water.

ThingDef.label: Cocoa
ThingDef.description: Unprocessed cocoa beans.

ThingDef.label: Mint
ThingDef.description: All species are highly aromatic, most of them contain a lot of menthol. Can be used in alchemy as a psychic stimulant.

ThingDef.label: Pumpkin
ThingDef.description: One of the most important and widespread vegetable crops, known for over 8 thousand years. Bulbs and leaves are used as a seasoning in the canning industry, for salads, vinaigrette, mushrooms, vegetable and meat dishes, as well as a spicy vitamin snack and flavoring additive to soups, sauces, minced meat.

ThingDef.label: Almond
ThingDef.description: A nut that serves as an excellent source of fat and calories.

ThingDef.label: Garlic
ThingDef.description: A plant with a vibrant flavor that helps enhance the flavor of a dish.

ThingDef.label: Zucchini
ThingDef.description: A bush variety of pumpkin with oblong fruits, without vines. The fruits can be green, yellow, black or white. The pulp is tender and quick-cooking.

ThingDef.label: Chili pepper
ThingDef.description: A plant with an extremely bright taste, sometimes helping to improve the taste of a dish.

ThingDef.label: Cabbage
ThingDef.description: A popular rocking plant, domesticated in various variations.

ThingDef.label: Sunflower
ThingDef.description: A plant from the aster family, the seeds of which are rich in all elements.

ThingDef.label: Eggplant
ThingDef.description: Herbaceous plant with bright purple fruits.

ThingDef.label: Beet
ThingDef.description: An important crop that is usually grown within one year.

ThingDef.label: Moss
ThingDef.description: Plucked wild forest moss. It has little nutritional value and is usually eaten only in salads to satisfy hunger.
